tools.name: edge_discover
tools.description: Get everything about the connected Edge account: plan, budget, enabled products with limits and regions, current projects, and full API documentation. Call this first in every session.

tools.name: edge_deploy_static_site
tools.description: Deploy a static website to Edge in one call: creates a storage bucket, uploads files (or clones a git repo), configures the global CDN with SSL, and wires DNS if the zone is on Edge. Free tier covers it. Provide either files (base64) or a git repo.

tools.name: edge_deploy_app
tools.description: Deploy a full application on a VM: provisions compute, runs a setup script, and optionally adds CDN and DNS. This is BILLABLE — always dry_run first and report the monthly cost to the user. Pass ssh_key (a public key string) to enable SSH access.

tools.name: edge_update_deployment
tools.description: Update an existing deployment: upload changed files and optionally purge the CDN cache.

tools.name: edge_list_projects
tools.description: List all projects (groupings of resources) on the connected Edge account.

tools.name: edge_project_health
tools.description: Comprehensive health check for every resource in a project: status, metrics, and actionable suggestions.

tools.name: edge_scale_project
tools.description: Scale the compute resources in a project up or down. BILLABLE — dry_run first and report the cost change to the user.

tools.name: edge_teardown_project
tools.description: PERMANENTLY delete a project and every resource in it (VMs, buckets, CDN deployments, DNS zones). Irreversible — only use when the user has clearly asked. Set confirm to true to execute.

tools.name: edge_list_vms
tools.description: List all virtual machines on the account with status, size, and IPs.

tools.name: edge_get_vm
tools.description: Get one VM: live status, metrics, IPs, attached SSH keys, and the ready-to-use SSH command. Poll until status is "running" before attempting SSH.

tools.name: edge_list_buckets
tools.description: List storage buckets on the account.

tools.name: edge_create_bucket
tools.description: Create an object storage bucket (S3-compatible). Free tier includes a limited number of buckets.

tools.name: edge_upload_files
tools.description: Upload files to an existing storage bucket.

tools.name: edge_list_dns_zones
tools.description: List DNS zones on the account.

tools.name: edge_create_dns_zone
tools.description: Create a DNS zone for a domain on Edge authoritative DNS. Free.

tools.name: edge_add_dns_record
tools.description: Add a DNS record to a zone.

tools.name: edge_list_shield_widgets
tools.description: List Edge Shield widgets (free, privacy-first CAPTCHA alternative).

tools.name: edge_create_shield_widget
tools.description: Create an Edge Shield widget to protect a form or page from bots. Free. Returns the sitekey, the secret (shown once — store it server-side), and a ready-to-paste embed snippet.

tools.name: edge_list_assist_sites
tools.description: List Edge Assist sites (AI answers widget) with usage and index status.

tools.name: edge_create_assist_site
tools.description: Create an Edge Assist site: AI answers for a website, grounded in its own content. Free tier: 1 site, 250 answered questions/month. Returns the sitekey and a one-line embed snippet.

tools.name: edge_account_status
tools.description: Check whether the connected account is a self-signed-up guest (explore tier) or fully claimed, and how to unlock it.

tools.name: edge_request_claim
tools.description: Nominate the human operator of a self-signed-up (explore tier) account. They receive an email with a claim link; claiming unlocks billable resources and stops the ~7 day auto-purge. Ask the user for their email address first.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: edge_request_claim · Private data: edge_deploy_static_site, edge_deploy_app, edge_update_deployment, edge_get_vm, edge_upload_files, edge_add_dns_record, edge_create_shield_widget · Public sink: edge_update_deployment, edge_upload_files, edge_request_claim · Destructive: edge_teardown_project.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: edge_request_claim · Private data: edge_deploy_static_site, edge_deploy_app, edge_update_deployment, edge_get_vm, edge_upload_files, edge_add_dns_record, edge_create_shield_widget · Public sink: edge_update_deployment, edge_upload_files, edge_request_claim · Destructive: edge_teardown_project

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
